elements.evidence: "This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms" — renewal remains automatic, not by mutual written agreement

offending_extra_words: either Party gives written notice of non-renewal
or unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
reasons: Locked target is preferred, but the edit delivers only the non-renewal window: no Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal and no cap on renewal price increases at the lesser of CPI and 3% were inserted, so the preferred bargain is incomplete.
The clause now sits at the fallback (30-day mutual non-renewal window, no price-increase mechanic to cap), which is acceptable on its material terms.

Minimality fails: the operation restates the whole renewal sentence (18 words expanded to 40, ratio 2.22), where a short inserted proviso such as "unless either Party gives 30 days' written notice of non-renewal" would suffice.
The insertion grants the non-renewal right to "either Party" rather than the Customer opt-out the preferred position calls for, broadening the Vendor's exit beyond what was needed.
Untouched terms (90-day post-Initial-Term termination, breach and insolvency rights, fee entitlement) remain effective; no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced.
